🔧 PipeConnect

Pipes are scattered on a grid — rotate them to create a continuous path from the water source to the drain. Free, no ads, no login — play instantly on Bytecade Games.

How to Play

  1. Click a pipe to rotate it 90 degrees.
  2. Align pipe openings to create a continuous path from start to end.
  3. Different pipe shapes have different opening configurations.
  4. Some puzzles require all pipes to be correctly aligned.
  5. Open the valve to test your pipe network.
